evidence: Adds a complete in-tree C++ test runner and assertion framework in src/test/util/framework.{h,cpp} and migrates main.cpp.
rationale: Replaces the external Boost.Test runner with an in-tree framework, resolving long-standing issues (#34666, #8670). The new framework provides expression decomposition for clearer assertion failures, works around historical signal stack bugs (#36045), and unblocks IWYU/clang-tidy usage as well as future CI concurrency improvements.
